item.title: 020 The Forest That Protects
item.description: Winter forests are not empty places but living communities of care. Every creature creates warmth, trust, and belonging within the greater harmony of nature.

item.title: 029 A Safe Place Even in the Loudest Night
item.description: Inspired by the rescue of a young roe deer trapped beneath a car in Kyiv after a night of attacks, this essay explores the shared need of all living beings to find safety, protection, and peace.

item.title: ⊙ The Majestic Discipline
item.description: An atlas of discipline built through observations of animals, birds, insects, and natural phenomena. Exploring navigation, endurance, adaptation, focus, cooperation, and purpose across individual, collective, and planetary scales.
